 WEEK 7 IS IN THE BOOKS AND THE LEAGUE IS OFFICIALLY COOKED 🔥 
 Let's start where we have to. Dana's Gridiron Gamblers has been the story of this season, the early crown, the Week 5 stumble at the hands of Punt Intended, and now a gutty 135-130 survive-and-advance over Fourth and Long. Five points. FIVE. Vasquez had Dana on the ropes and couldn't close it out, which is brutal considering Fourth and Long is sitting at 3-4 with nearly 1,000 points scored. That team should be so much better than their record. The football gods are not kind.
 Speaking of unkind, let's talk about Kel's Autodrafters dropping a 184-point nuclear bomb on Sunday Scaries 💥. That's not a fantasy score, that's a statement. Kel rolls into Week 7 as your MVP, your Blowout King, and honestly your most dangerous team in this league right now. 5-2 with 994 points scored, nearly matching Dana point for point on the season. That race for the top seed just got very real.
 Meanwhile Couch Coaches squeaked out a 2-point win over Waiver Wire Villains. TWO POINTS. Someone's heart is still on the floor over that one. Punt Intended also came through big, knocking off The Kneel Downs by 16 to stay alive in the playoff picture.
 And then there's Bench Mob. 91 points. 🤡 Lowest score of the week, lost to Hail Mary Inc, and is now 3-4 staring at the bubble.
 Playoff picture: Dana leads, Kel and the 5-2 pack are right there, and the 3-4 teams are running out of rope fast. Next week could make or break three or four seasons at once. Who's ready?
 #BeersAndBadDecisions #Week7 #PlayoffPush 

 MATCHUP OF THE WEEK. WEEK 8. BEERS AND BAD DECISIONS. 🍺
 Punt Intended (4-3) vs. Couch Coaches (5-2) 
 THE SETUP 🔥 
 Buckle up degenerates, because this week we've got a genuine playoff seeding battle wrapped in a delicious revenge narrative. Punt Intended is riding a three-game win streak like they just discovered fantasy football and nobody told them it was supposed to be hard. Couch Coaches is sitting pretty at 5-2 but they've been here before, and last time they left Punt Intended crying in the parking lot by 38 points.
 THE HISTORY 😬 
 Zero. Punt Intended is a big fat 0-2 all-time against Couch Coaches, and it hasn't even been close. We're talking an average margin of 32 points. THIRTY TWO. That's not a rivalry, that's a recurring nightmare. In fact, after the last beatdown, Whitfield's squad got temporarily renamed "Couch Slouches" by the league's own recap machine. That's not a loss, that's a public execution.
 THE PREDICTION 🎯 
 I'm riding with Punt Intended here. The hot hand matters, the revenge arc is too perfect to ignore, and Whitfield's squad just showed last week they're mortal. Upset special. Punt Intended 131, Couch Coaches 118. 
 TRASH TALK AMMUNITION 🗣️ 
 For Punt Intended: "Your whole head-to-head record against these guys looks like your bank account after a bad weekend. Time to collect."
 For Couch Coaches: "Congrats on the win streak, but Punt Intended just dropped 149 on someone last week. You sure you want this smoke?"
